era: Krakoan Era (House of X / Powers of X)

factions.description: The supreme executive, legislative, and judicial governing branch of Krakoa.

characters.name: Charles Xavier
characters.krakoan_function: Manages the global Cerebro network to maintain up-to-date mutant mind-backups for resurrection.
characters.bio: Founder of the X-Men who abandoned his dream of peaceful coexistence to establish a sovereign mutant nation. Shedding his wheelchair for a sleek hover-chair and a permanent Cerebro helmet, Xavier rules Krakoa with a cold, calculated pragmatism, holding the keys to mutant immortality.

characters.name: Max Eisenhardt
characters.krakoan_function: Acts as the nation's primary geopolitical defender and official voice to human governments.
characters.bio: The former mutant terrorist whose separatist philosophy became the structural baseline for Krakoa. Serving as the primary political muscle and chief diplomat of the nation, Magneto works alongside his oldest friend, Charles Xavier, to fiercely defend their borders from human interference.

characters.name: En Sabah Nur
characters.krakoan_function: Drives Krakoan external magic systems and facilitates reunification with the lost continent of Arakko.
characters.bio: An ancient, immortal mutant who sees Krakoa as the ultimate realization of his 'survival of the fittest' doctrine. Shifting his focus from brutal warfare to ancient mutant sorcery, he guides the nation toward an occult confrontation to reclaim their long-lost sister island, Arakko.

characters.name: Nathaniel Essex
characters.primary_power: Cellular Regeneration / Stolen Mutant DNA Telepathy
characters.krakoan_function: Maintains the complete, definitive mutant DNA catalog necessary to clone bodies for resurrection.
characters.bio: A theatrical, untrustworthy geneticist granted amnesty because his massive sequence database of mutant DNA is vital to the resurrection process. Flamboyant and deeply untrustworthy, Sinister constantly schemes behind the Council's back while hiding dangerous secrets about his clones.

characters.name: Raven Darkhölme
characters.krakoan_function: Executes state-mandated espionage while secretly working to resurrect her wife, Destiny.
characters.bio: A master shapeshifter and veteran operative weaponized by the Quiet Council for deniable, wet-work black-ops missions. Her loyalty is entirely transactional; she serves the state only under the condition that Xavier and Magneto fulfill their promise to resurrect her deceased wife, Destiny.

characters.name: Bennet du Paris
characters.krakoan_function: Spreads Krakoan exceptionalism, cultural dogma, and religious mythology to the young mutant population.
characters.bio: A 12th-century French crusader turned ultra-powerful mutant extremist. Exodus views Krakoan resurrection as divine ascendance, transforming himself into the high priest of mutant exceptionalism and molding the minds of younger generations to view mutants as literal gods on Earth.

characters.name: Emma Frost
characters.krakoan_function: Heads the Hellfire Trading Company; manages the legal export of life-saving Krakoan pharmaceuticals.
characters.bio: The brilliant and fashionable former leader of the Hellfire Club who secured her power by weaponizing economic infrastructure. She runs global distribution of Krakoa's miracle drugs, leveraging human health dependencies to secure international sovereignty and financial dominance.

characters.name: Sebastian Shaw
characters.krakoan_function: Runs illicit distribution channels to smuggle Krakoan medicines into non-treaty human nations.
characters.bio: A cutthroat corporate billionaire forced into a tense economic alliance with Emma Frost. Shaw commands the illicit black-market division of the Hellfire Trading Company, weaponizing corruption, smuggling operations, and corporate back-stabbing to maximize his personal influence.

characters.name: Kate Pryde
characters.krakoan_function: Commands the Marauders to liberate and smuggle mutants physically trapped by hostile human regimes.
characters.bio: The veteran X-Man who took to the high seas after discovering she inexplicably cannot pass through Krakoa's organic transport gates. Adopting a pirate persona, she commands a seafaring rescue crew that liberates mutants trapped within hostile, anti-mutant human nations.

characters.name: Ororo Munroe
characters.krakoan_function: Serves as Regent of Arakko (Mars), representing mutantkind's expansion on a cosmic scale.
characters.bio: A revered veteran hero who commands the physical element of weather. Finding herself too grand for the localized political squabbles of the Council, she eventually migrates to terraformed Mars (Arakko), successfully claiming leadership over an entire society of battle-hardened mutants.

characters.name: Jean Grey
characters.krakoan_function: Balances pragmatism with classic X-Men morality; serves as elite field enforcement.
characters.bio: One of the most powerful psychics on Earth, Jean acts as the emotional and moral center of Krakoa's governance. While she participates in the state's severe systemic operations, she frequently pushes back against the council's darker compromises to preserve classic X-Men heroism.

characters.name: Kurt Wagner
characters.krakoan_function: Drafts Krakoan jurisprudence, legal ethics, and pioneers the mutant nation's cultural philosophy.
characters.bio: A deeply religious and empathetic swashbuckler who experiences a profound spiritual crisis over mutant immortality. Tasked with crafting a brand-new moral philosophy and legal code for a society that has beaten death, he focuses on fostering local art, soul, and custom.

characters.name: Doug Ramsey
characters.krakoan_function: The sole communications link capable of translating, speaking with, and mapping the living island.
characters.bio: A young mutant with the passive ability to comprehend any written, spoken, or digital language. Because he is the only entity capable of communicating directly with the sentient landmass of Krakoa, he sits on the council as an indispensable, independent bridge between nation and land.

characters.name: Krakoa
characters.krakoan_function: The living, breathing landmass that acts as the physical, structural home of the mutant race.
characters.bio: An ancient, predatory living landmass that feeds on mutant bio-energy. Fed and placated by Xavier through a sustainable symbiotic deal, Krakoa morphs its entire geography to serve as a hyper-advanced, organic sanctuary, sprouting portals, habitats, and flora worldwide.

factions.description: The biological collective whose unified mutant circuits achieve perfect mutant resurrection.

characters.name: Hope Summers
characters.krakoan_function: Unifies, synchronizes, and boosts the powers of the other four members to make the loop possible.
characters.bio: The mutant messiah born to save her species from extinction. As the undisputed focal point of 'The Five', her power mimicry perfectly synchronizes, regulates, and stabilizes the individual abilities of her teammates, linking their minds and bodies into a flawless, unbroken assembly line.

characters.name: Fabio Medina
characters.krakoan_function: Produces hollow, biological, organic eggs that serve as incubation pods for cloning mutant husks.
characters.bio: Originally a joke superhero who shot harmless golden spheres from his chest, Fabio discovered his power was fundamentally misunderstood. Under Krakoan science, his spheres are recognized as unfertilized, biological eggs, making him the foundational physical shell provider for cloning.

characters.name: Kevin MacTaggert
characters.krakoan_function: Alters physical reality to make unviable biological shells compatible with baseline mutant physiology.
characters.bio: A tragic, energy-based reality warper who historically burnt through human host bodies in agony. Sustained by Krakoan technology and clones, he wraps his volatile mind around Fabio’s fragile eggs, warping their atomic structure to make them biologically viable for genetic integration.

characters.name: Joshua Foley
characters.krakoan_function: Triggers rapid cell replication, mapping correct genetic strains to spark cellular life.
characters.bio: A powerful bio-kinetic healer capable of rewriting organic structures at a molecular level. Within the resurrection loop, Elixir steps in after Proteus, using his power to instantly trigger cell division, organogenesis, and the flawless imprint of DNA patterns into the growing body.

characters.name: Eva Bell
characters.krakoan_function: Generates localized temporal bubbles to age the cloned body rapidly to its exact age of death.
characters.bio: An Australian chronokinetic mutant capable of trapping targets in time loops. She solves the problem of gestation by casting hyper-accelerated temporal fields directly over the fertilized mutant eggs, aging the biological clones from raw cell clusters to mature adulthood in mere hours.

factions.description: Military commanders vested with complete tactical control during active combat operations.

characters.name: Scott Summers
characters.krakoan_function: Chief strategist of Krakoa; holds veto power over the Quiet Council during martial law emergencies.
characters.bio: The ultimate field leader of mutantkind. While step-parents Xavier and Magneto handle politics, Cyclops establishes the military defense protocols of the nation. He commands absolute tactical authority on the battlefield, answering to no politician when mutant lives are on the line.

characters.name: Illyana Rasputina
characters.krakoan_function: Manages massive troop routing and instant spatial deployment using her Limbo teleportation gates.
characters.bio: The demonic Sorceress Supreme of the Limbo dimension and a battle-tested frontline warrior. Using her spatial stepping discs, Magik acts as Krakoa's ultimate logistics and vanguard commander, capable of instantly mobilizing entire army battalions anywhere across the known universe.

characters.name: Lucas Bishop
characters.krakoan_function: Structures internal defense parameters, threat-mapping, and domestic perimeter protection.
characters.bio: A battle-hardened, time-traveling soldier born in a dystopian future where mutants were hunted to extinction. Obsessed with preventing that reality from ever happening, Bishop manages tactical counter-insurgency plans and designs internal military grid frameworks for the island.

characters.name: Tomi Shishido
characters.krakoan_function: Acts as elite physical security defense detail for diplomatic envoys traveling abroad.
characters.bio: A lethal, nihilistic mass murderer and former high-ranking leader of the Hand ninja clan. Granted state immunity, Gorgon is repurposed as Krakoa's ultimate executioner and close-quarters bodyguard, guarding Council politicians during critical, high-risk human diplomatic summits.

factions.description: The hidden minds behind Krakoa's structural framework.

characters.name: Moira MacTaggert
characters.krakoan_function: Uses foresight from 9 past failed lives to architect the survival loop of Krakoa alongside Xavier and Magneto.
characters.bio: Long believed to be a baseline human ally, Moira is revealed to be the most dangerous mutant alive, possessing the power of temporal reincarnation. Having lived and died through nine past alternate timelines—witnessing mutants lose every single time—she uses her historical data to design Krakoa.

characters.name: Forge
characters.krakoan_function: Re-engineered the global Cerebro database to scale across planetary servers, handling millions of mutant soul-backups.
characters.bio: A Native American technopath who can intuitively invent any mechanical system he imagines. Forge upgraded Xavier's singular Cerebro unit into a global network of logic arrays and space-bound satellites, scaling data bandwidth to store and synchronize millions of mutant souls simultaneously.
